disambiguation: It manages weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes internally, replacing the need for the Periodic Notes plugin.
extras: Handles migration from Periodic Notes and requires specific CSS class targeting (#calendar-container) for customization.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of the original Liam Cain Calendar Plugin that brings the plugin on par with modern Obsidian.
motivation: The author built it to bring the original plugin up to modern Obsidian standards.
problem: The original calendar plugin was outdated, and users needed a modern, functional calendar view for organizing and navigating daily notes.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of the original Liam Cain Calendar Plugin
This replaces the Periodic Notes plugin: see Periodic notes.

summary: Calendar Reborn provides a visual calendar interface for daily notes, allowing users to navigate, create, and track writing volume across various time scales.
